title: Which Egg Hides the Dragon?
youtube_title: 🥚 Which Egg Is Hiding the Dragon? #Shorts
youtube_description:
Can YOU guess which egg has the dragon inside? Blue, gold, or spotted? Watch to find out! 🐉🔥

#Shorts #KidsVideo #GuessingGame #Dragon #Kidify #FunForKids #Quiz #Puzzle

scenes.narration: One of these eggs is hiding a DRAGON — but which one?
Is it the blue egg, the gold egg, or the spotted egg? You have three seconds to decide!
The blue egg? You crack it open and… it's a rubber duck! Quack quack!
The gold egg? Ooh, so shiny… but inside is just a pile of glitter. So much glitter!
That means the SPOTTED egg has the dragon! It's hatching right now — look at those little wings!
Did you get it right? Tomorrow we go to Level Two — can you beat an even trickier challenge?
